# Resona

> Resona is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) system-wide sound enhancer for Linux. It is a Dolby Atmos / DTS / Realtek Audio Console–style experience for PipeWire, and an alternative to EasyEffects and JamesDSP. Repository: https://github.com/noble6/resona

Resona adds a virtual "Resona Sound" output to PipeWire. All desktop audio passes through a native, lock-free C DSP engine (a LADSPA plugin hosted by PipeWire's filter-chain, ~1% of one CPU core, 1.5 ms latency), then plays on the real device. The UI is PySide6/QML in Material 3 Expressive style.

## What it does
- One-click sound profiles (Dynamic, Music, Movie, Gaming, Voice, Night, Pure) with device modes (headphones, speakers, laptop)
- Spatial HRTF: binaural virtual speakers for headphones (Brown–Duda structural head model), no IR file needed
- DeepBass: psychoacoustic missing-fundamental bass for small and laptop speakers, with Balanced, Sub Boost, Punchy and Warm bass types (like the bass modes in Dolby apps on Android)
- Intelligent EQ: content-adaptive tonal balance (Balanced/Warm/Focused/Bright), similar in spirit to Dolby's Intelligent Equalizer
- Smart Leveler (volume-aware AGC), Adaptive Loudness (equal-loudness compensation), Voice Focus (dialogue enhancer), Clarity exciter, Tube Warmth, 3D Stage, crossfeed, ambience reverb, lookahead limiter, 10-band EQ
- Headphone correction: built-in search of the AutoEq database (~8,800 headphones); imports EqualizerAPO/AutoEq ParametricEQ.txt and ViPER4Android DDC (.vdc) files
- Convolver for ViPER/JamesDSP .irs and .wav impulse responses (mono, stereo, true stereo)
- Stereo → 5.1/7.1 surround upmix for HDMI AV receivers, analog 5.1 and S/PDIF optical Dolby Digital (AC3)
- Hardware detection: sound cards, codecs (e.g. Realtek ALC), jacks, HDMI display audio capabilities (ELD), output-mode switching, Hi-Res native sample rates (44.1–192 kHz), studio resampler, Bluetooth codec switching (LDAC/aptX/AAC)
- Per-device memory, per-app automatic profiles, presets (JSON), tray, follows output switching
- Built-in updater that installs new GitHub releases on demand, weekly or monthly

## Install
git clone https://github.com/noble6/resona && cd resona && ./install.sh
Needs PipeWire + pipewire-pulse + WirePlumber, Python 3.10+, PySide6 (Qt 6.7+), numpy, a C compiler. Arch package: packaging/aur/PKGBUILD.
